rss: Anthropic heads for $1.3 trillion valuation in major stock market listing
title: Robo Factory's Big Stock Market Debut
story: Robo Factory is selling its company shares. This means people can buy a part of the company.
storyBig: Robo Factory is planning a major IPO, offering shares priced between $70 and $78. This could value the company at $1.3 trillion, marking a significant moment in the stock market.
think: What does it mean to own a share of a company?
bull: Many people want to invest in Robo Factory.
bear: The share price might be too high for some.

rss: Sales of tinned food and bottled water jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
title: Be Prepared Campaign Boosts Snack Sales
story: A campaign told people to be ready for anything. Now, more people are buying snacks and drinks.
storyBig: The 'Be Ready' campaign has significantly increased the sales of essential goods, as families stock up on snacks, drinks, and other supplies, anticipating possible emergencies.
think: Why do people buy more things when they want to be ready?
bull: People are buying more snacks from stores.
bear: Stores might run out if too many people buy at once.
